name: Relay repo handoff
description: Repo-local WorkContext message example for handing implementation context between Relay agents; not a universal Relay payload schema.

fields.scope: Relay issue, PR, WorkContext, or code area this handoff covers.
fields.exactHead: Branch and commit SHA the handoff evidence applies to.
fields.handoffSummary: Concrete work completed and current state, without private local paths or raw logs.
fields.nextStep: The next role/action expected from the receiving agent or operator.
fields.risks: Known unresolved risks, assumptions, or intentionally skipped checks.
